text:
elaine: Heads-up: planning a small DP wave focused on Private + Dedicated onboarding. Need to lock commitments: sync cadence, minimal SLA, and intake qualification. Thoughts?

sami: keep syncs optional. Recommend 25-30m focused sessions for teams that opt-in. Async-first otherwise.

juan: agree. Also need clarity on what counts as a blocking issue so engineering can triage correctly.

elaine: draft plan: opt-in synchronous track (30m/week for first 3 weeks, then 30m biweekly), default async track. Qualifier = completed integration checklist + one smoke call to staging. No-show twice -> downgrade to async.

marie: success signals: activation within 7 days (>=3 meaningful calls), post-sync usefulness >=4/5, and reported regressions per DP <=2/week.

juan: propose P1 definition: anything that prevents DP from progressing in core flows or causes data integrity loss. For intensive weeks we can run a 1-month dev rotation for faster turnarounds.

sami: onboarding kit items: integration checklist, quickstart snippet, runbook (where to find logs), and a meeting agenda template. I'll assemble.

elaine: ops-bot, can you create a dp-regression intake label and a small GH workflow to surface regressions to rotation? Also auto-post a one-line update into the per-DP slack thread.

ops-bot: done. Label `dp-regression` added. Workflow will create an issue and post a short message to the DP thread when labeled.

marie: I'll own the post-sync survey and weekly rollup dashboard. Minimal survey: usefulness (1-5), regressions Y/N, top ask.

elaine: actions: sami -> onboarding kit (48h), juan -> rotation names/coverage (48h), marie -> survey + dashboard spec (72h), ops-bot -> GH workflow + thread template (24h). If no objections, I'll add to pilot ops doc and start scheduling. :wave:
